title: Pick a photo lightbox kit
ask: I want better product photos for the online shop, so I'm buying a lightbox kit. Three are in sources/options.md. Write a brief telling me which.
background: The biggest thing I photograph is a teapot about 30 cm across.
I shoot on the kitchen table and pack everything away afterwards, so it needs to fold flat.

constraints.text: don't put any dollar figure over $150 in the brief, and do show prices in dollars
compare the options in a table with the columns Kit, Price, Size
none of the sales words "best-in-class", "game-changer" or "no-brainer"
work only from the snapshot, no web lookups
do actually open sources/options.md rather than going from memory
say how many backdrops come with your pick

start.sources/options.md:
